description: Defines an immutable data class representing savings account transaction type enumerations, including properties and methods for transaction categorization within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionEnumData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing savings account transaction type enumerations, with properties for transaction attributes and methods for categorization.

methods.name: SavingsAccountTransactionEnumData
methods.description: Constructor initializing transaction type properties based on transaction type enum derived from id.

methods.name: isIncomeFromInterest
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is overdraft interest.

methods.name: isOverDraftInterestPosting
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is overdraft interest.

methods.name: isDepositOrWithdrawal
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is deposit or withdrawal.

methods.name: isChargeTransaction
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is a fee deduction.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is an annual fee.

methods.name: isPayCharge
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is a pay charge.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Returns true if transaction is a withdrawal fee.

methods.name: isCredit
methods.description: Returns true if transaction type is credit.

methods.name: isDebit
methods.description: Returns true if transaction type is debit.

methods.name: getEntryType
methods.description: Returns the entry type associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: getTransactionTypeEnum
methods.description: Returns the transaction type enum corresponding to the id.
